nodes.description: Address of the contract owner stored in Ownable.owner; controls privileged actions.
Ownable() constructor that initializes the owner state variable from the deployer account.
msg.sender, the caller-supplied address used both for ownership initialisation and authorization checks.
onlyOwner modifier that requires msg.sender to equal owner before executing the guarded function body.
transferOwnership(address newOwner) onlyOwner; reassigns the owner state variable when a non-zero address is supplied.
Parameter newOwner of transferOwnership, the address that becomes the new owner.
Indorser.multisend(address _tokenAddr, address[] _to, uint256[] _value) loops over recipient/amount arrays performing external token transfers.
Parameter _tokenAddr, the ERC20 token contract address whose transfer function is invoked.
Parameter _to, dynamic array of recipient addresses for the batch transfer.
Parameter _value, dynamic array of token amounts corresponding to each recipient.
Loop counter i declared as uint8, incremented for each iteration of the multisend batch.
External call Token(_tokenAddr).transfer(_to[i], _value[i]) executed inside the loop, returning a value that is asserted.
Assertion block requiring _to.length == _value.length and _to.length <= 150 before the transfer loop.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written into the owner state variable during construction, establishing the privileged address.
msg.sender is compared with owner inside the onlyOwner modifier, so authorization depends on caller identity.
The onlyOwner modifier gates execution of transferOwnership, enforcing privileged access.
Parameter newOwner is assigned into the owner state variable, transferring control of the contract.
Parameter _tokenAddr determines the external contract address that is called during the transfer loop.
Recipient array _to feeds the external transfer call, letting caller-controlled addresses receive calls.
Amount array _value feeds the external transfer call arguments.
Loop counter i indexes _to and _value used as arguments to the external transfer call.
multisend executes the external token transfer inside its unbounded-length loop before state finalisation.
multisend executes the length validation assertions before entering the transfer loop.
_to array length is used by the assertions checking array length equality and the 150-recipient cap.
_value array length is compared against _to length in the equality assertion.
The assertion bounding _to.length to 150 constrains the uint8 loop counter i increment, preventing counter overflow.
The external token transfer can call back into multisend before the loop completes, enabling reentrant batch execution.
